verdict.rationale: Kong's evidence focuses on AI Gateway/MCP traffic management (routing LLM calls, semantic security, observability plugins) but none of it shows Kong itself analyzing a user's own API/traffic data to generate AI insights or suggestions inside the product (e.g., an AI copilot summarizing gateway usage or recommending config changes). This is a plausible feature for a management platform like Konnect, so the axis applies, but no evidence supports it.
